transforms: MenuEntry.fx2_id 0x1f -> 0x09: 0x1f is TAPEHEAD's and 0x1e Airwindows Chorus's in Modwerk; the registry refuses two modules on one id. A comment says so; the author's own comment on 0x1f is kept.

Docstring: the first paragraph names both ids. Harness layout_char 'F', every Param, the tables, mode views, proof note and dear settings are unchanged.
Moved from tools/verify/ into the module folder (tools/ is shared build input); the toolpath line and the usage line follow the new location.

octabam's audition._ensure_insert_mem builds its scratch image from the insert plus SEND with fallback SEND. Modwerk's tree has no SEND module, so the script builds the scratch image itself with the same build line and dump: LOFI2 alone, fallback NONE, static_stock=True; the user's out/mainos_bus.bin is saved and restored as before.
The 'module is really in the image' guard compares LOFI2's dispatch entries with an id absent from the scratch image (TAPEHEAD's) instead of SEND's.
All 48 checks, their inputs and their limits are unchanged.
